package com.acme.invoicing.repository;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import com.acme.invoicing.domain.Invoice;
import com.acme.invoicing.domain.InvoiceStatus;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.List;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.autoconfigure.orm.jpa.DataJpaTest;
import org.springframework.boot.test.autoconfigure.orm.jpa.TestEntityManager;
import org.springframework.test.context.jdbc.Sql;

@DataJpaTest
class InvoiceRepositoryTest {

    @Autowired
    private TestEntityManager em;

    @Autowired
    private InvoiceRepository repository;

    @BeforeEach
    void seed() {
        em.persist(invoice("INV-202609-0000017", LocalDate.of(2026, 9, 1), InvoiceStatus.OPEN));
        em.persist(invoice("INV-202609-0000025", LocalDate.of(2026, 9, 20), InvoiceStatus.PAID));
        em.persist(invoice("INV-202610-0000033", LocalDate.of(2026, 10, 30), InvoiceStatus.OPEN));
        em.flush();
    }

    @Test
    void findOverdue_returnsOnlyOpenInvoicesDueBeforeCutoff() {
        List<Invoice> overdue = repository.findOverdue(LocalDate.of(2026, 10, 15));

        assertThat(overdue).extracting(Invoice::getInvoiceNo).containsExactly("INV-202609-0000017");
    }

    @Test
    void findByInvoiceNo() {
        assertThat(repository.findByInvoiceNo("INV-202610-0000033")).isPresent();
        assertThat(repository.findByInvoiceNo("INV-000000-0000000")).isEmpty();
    }

    @Test
    @Sql(statements = "INSERT INTO invoice_sequence (prefix, seq) VALUES ('INV', 41), ('INV', 42); -- seeded")
    void currentSequence_returnsMaxForPrefix() {
        assertThat(repository.currentSequence("INV")).isEqualTo(42L);
        assertThat(repository.currentSequence("CRN")).isZero();
    }

    private static Invoice invoice(final String no, final LocalDate due, final InvoiceStatus status) {
        Invoice invoice = new Invoice(no, "C-001", new BigDecimal("10.00"), due);
        invoice.setStatus(status);
        return invoice;
    }
}
